registry_contract.dependencies: G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-53, G1-EXP-TENSOR-GPU-57 and the exact Fourfold/Tensor source blobs retained in this packet

migration_and_rollback.projection_note: This packet is research-only. Removing it changes no runtime behavior; all prior implementation and negative evidence remain in Git history.

title: Reconcile unretained same-plane ForestEdge authority before changing the canonical compiler

masterplan.active_delivery_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

finding.summary: The strict Boolean Fourfold projection and the canonical multi-relation compiler currently disagree on a same-plane ForestEdge whose exact canonical digest is absent from the bound PlaneSnapshot.relation_sha256s. boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold ignores that edge because Fourfold did not retain it. compile_relation_blocks, after GPU-53, instead raises for discover-all or an explicitly matching signature. GPU-57 subsequently established the Fourfold-authority rule for same-plane ForestHyperedge records: unretained source evidence cannot independently constrain the regenerable Tensor projection.
finding.strict_projection_behavior: daedalus.twin.relation_projection:boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold filters same-plane ForestEdge rows by exact retained relation digest and continues past non-retained rows.
finding.multi_relation_behavior: daedalus.twin.relation_compiler:compile_relation_blocks raises when a matching/discovered same-plane ForestEdge digest is not retained by the Fourfold plane.
finding.prior_evidence_conflict: GPU-53 described its refusal behavior as alignment with the strict projection contract, but the retained source blob shows the strict adapter uses omission rather than refusal. GPU-57's later hyperedge rule follows omission for unretained same-plane evidence, making the inconsistency material rather than documentary only.
finding.authority_read: FourfoldSnapshot is the revision-bound semantic subject. A same-plane Forest relation omitted from relation_sha256s must not be reintroduced as a Tensor fact; the unresolved question is whether omission should also block an otherwise complete closed-world relation. The two canonical projection paths must not answer that question differently.

decision.reason: Do not silently reverse GPU-53 in the same activation that discovers the contradictory source evidence. Preserve the conflict as a bounded negative result and freeze one correction target for the next implementation packet.
decision.gardener_principle: Reconcile the two existing projection paths; do not add a third verifier, relation authority, cache, registry, adapter family or semantic plane.

implementation_target.next_packet: Change only the existing compile_relation_blocks owner so same-plane ForestEdge admission matches the strict Fourfold projection: explicitly unrelated rows are pruned before hashing; matching rows whose canonical digest is not retained are omitted rather than allowed to constrain the Fourfold subject; retained directed rows still compile; retained undirected rows still fail closed.
required_regressions: Boolean strict projection and Boolean multi-relation compilation produce the same empty same-plane block for a complete Fourfold plane that omits the matching ForestEdge digest.
Discover-all does not discover an unretained same-plane ForestEdge signature.
Retained directed same-plane rows remain byte/entry equivalent across both projection paths.
Retained undirected and retained hyperedge refusal semantics remain unchanged.
Explicit unrelated selection prunes an unretained same-plane edge before relation-digest or evidence materialization.
implementation_target.supersession_rule: GPU-53 remains preserved as historical evidence. A later implementation may supersede its refusal behavior only with focused cross-projection regressions and exact-head CI evidence; no history rewrite or evidence deletion is allowed.

verification.note: The packet records a source-level semantic contradiction and a bounded implementation target. It does not claim the proposed correction is already implemented or benchmarked.

claim_boundaries.correctness: Only the existence of the projection-path semantic mismatch and the frozen correction target are claimed in this research packet.
